versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the WordPress MCP OpenClaw integration.
- Connect OpenClaw to any WordPress site running Immens MCP Fortress and access 274+ WordPress management tools.
- Secure authentication with SHA-256 hashed API keys, IP whitelisting, and rate limiting.
- Manage posts, media, comments, users, WooCommerce, SEO, and more via MCP tools.
- Auto-discovery and broad plugin integration support (including Pro-only features).
- Comprehensive documentation for configuration, security, and troubleshooting.
